definition.title: Composable domain knowledge V1
definition.purpose: Deliver passive shared knowledge and authorized optional contextual access in Design.

nodes.title: Shared knowledge content
nodes.objective: Input: authored advisory Markdown and package metadata. Output: flat data-only workspace. No runtime code or dependencies; never modified by App or Agent. Failure owner: package admission.

criteria.title: Shared knowledge content verified against acceptance tests

nodes.title: Optional scoped knowledge access
nodes.objective: Input: trusted metadata, authorization and provider. Output: scoped discovery and deterministic advisory resolution. Optional when absent; no filesystem, tool execution or knowledge writes from read sessions. Admin changes invalidate request reuse; failures reject at Runtime.

criteria.title: Optional scoped knowledge access verified against acceptance tests

nodes.title: Design knowledge integration
nodes.objective: Input: allowlisted files and trusted request identity. Output: deferred metadata/read tools through existing host. No admin tools; no canonical mutation. App owns file admission, relevance, content and failure; Runtime owns context reuse.

criteria.title: Design knowledge integration verified against acceptance tests

nodes.title: Integrated verification and PR
nodes.objective: Input: integrated candidate. Output: scoped passing gates and reviewable PR. Preserve ordinary permissions, transaction and provider behavior; no merge or publication. Failure owner: affected gate owner.

criteria.title: Integrated verification and PR verified against acceptance tests
All acceptance cases and preserved behavior verified on delivered source

observations.summary: 343 selected repository/source tests passed, one existing skip. Content-only final aggregation and immutable knowledge source capture regressions passed.
